headline: Anupam Rasayan India Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Anupam Rasayan India Limited has informed the Exchange about Letter of Offer regarding the open offer for acquisition of fully paid-up equity shares of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited from the Public Shareholders, by the Company…
detail: General Updates - Anupam Rasayan India Limited has informed the Exchange about Letter of Offer regarding the open offer for acquisition of fully paid-up equity shares of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited from the Public Shareholders, by the Company together with PAC.
